scores.reliability: baseline reliability + fulfilled promises + corroborated reports + voluntary bad news - contradictions - manipulation - relapse concealment
scores.access: current network access - time since custody - exposure - faction purge
scores.exposure: mission use + communication frequency + visible protection changes + enemy counterintelligence
scores.doubleAgentRisk: profile risk + conflicting loyalty + coercion + uncorroborated success - transparent motivation - handler trust

handlerRules: One primary handler and one backup.
Handler cannot make sentencing promises outside authority.
Do not use an informant to provoke crimes they would not otherwise commit.
A rehabilitating person is not required to become an informant.
